channel.title: Signet Artists | Blog
channel.description: Occasional writing on live music for private events: planning it, pricing it, and the music itself. From Signet Artists in Denver.

item.title: Why does music bring back memories?
item.description: Why does music bring back memories? What studies found about music and memory, nostalgia and 'our song', and how to use it at an anniversary party.

item.title: Why do restaurants have live music?
item.description: Why restaurants have live music: what studies found about music, how long guests stay and what they spend, how loud it should be, and what isn't known.

item.title: Why do people sing along?
item.description: Why people sing along at concerts and parties: what a study of 1,054 songs found gets a crowd singing, and whether singing together brings people closer.

item.title: Why do people play music at funerals?
item.description: Why music is part of a funeral, how families choose the song, what people often pick, and whether it has to be a hymn, from studies of funerals and families.

item.title: Why do dementia patients remember music?
item.description: Why people with dementia often remember old songs, what a song can bring back, which songs last, and what researchers found music can't do for memory.

item.title: What music do 80 year olds listen to?
item.description: What music 80 and 90 year olds tend to like: research on the years people remember best, the years by age, and how to find out what one person loves.

item.title: Sing-along songs for seniors
item.description: Sing-along songs for seniors from our own song list, how to choose more by the years residents grew up in, and what studies of group singing found.

item.title: Last song of the night at a wedding
item.description: Why the last song of the night at a wedding matters: research on how people remember an ending, and how couples choose an upbeat or a slow last song.

item.title: Karaoke team building
item.description: Is karaoke good for team building? What studies of singing together show about feeling close, what they don't show about teamwork, and live band karaoke.

item.title: Does music make food taste better?
item.description: Does music make food taste better? What studies found about noise and taste, music and wine, and the best music for a dinner party.

item.title: Party music for all ages
item.description: Party music for all ages: research on which decades each generation remembers best, a table by guest age, and how to pick songs everyone enjoys.

item.title: Live music for memory care residents
item.description: What research says live music can and can't do for memory care residents: engagement, the songs that matter most, hearing, and what doesn't hold up.

item.title: Is live music better than recorded?
item.description: Is live music better than recorded? Studies found people move more and feel more connected to each other at a live show. Here's what holds up.

item.title: How to get people to dance at a wedding
item.description: How to get people to dance at a wedding, from research on real dance floors: songs people know, the tempo they move to, bass and live bands.

item.title: How does music affect people at a party?
item.description: How does music affect people at a party? What research shows about volume, dancing, age, live music and drinking, and the claims that don't hold up.

item.title: Does loud music make people drink more?
item.description: Does loud music make people drink more? The best-known study is small and comes from a lab whose work is in question. Here's what the research shows.

item.title: Do sound baths work?
item.description: Do sound baths work? People report feeling calmer and less tense, and small studies agree, but no health benefit is proven. Here's what the research says.

item.title: What is yacht rock?
item.description: What yacht rock is: the smooth soft rock of the late 1970s and early 80s, why it's called that, how it differs from soft rock, the songs, and how to throw a yacht rock party.

item.title: What is Americana music?
item.description: What Americana music is, how it differs from country, folk and bluegrass, the instruments, the artists and songs, and which size of Americana band to book for a Colorado reception, retreat or wedding.

item.title: What is a string quartet?
item.description: A string quartet is two violins, a viola and a cello. What each one plays, how a trio or a solo violinist compares, and the songs strings play for a wedding aisle.
